annotations.title: Launch checklist for a browser game

description: Use when someone's browser game is finished or about to go live and they ask what to do before launch, how to publish, deploy or share it, or where to put it. Returns a short ordered checklist to go through with them: loads fast, works on a phone or says it needs a keyboard, title, description and share image, a free place to host it, where to list it, and the first players. Given the play link, the listing step carries the free Foundplay listing link, or the game's page if it is already listed. Read-only; it does not open or test the game. For an existing listing's plays, use check_game.

playUrl.description: Optional. Where people play the game, starting with https://.

name: get_launch_checklist

outputSchema.description: An ordered launch checklist for a browser game.

listed.description: With a play link: whether the game is on Foundplay. Null without one.

next.description: The next step, stated as a fact about where things stand.

link.description: A link for the step, or null.
